WaitUntil.description:
Page-lifecycle checkpoint a navigation should wait on.

Mapping to CDP `Page.lifecycleEvent` names:
* `Load` → `load`
* `DomContentLoaded` → `DOMContentLoaded`
* `NetworkIdle` → `networkIdle`
* `Commit` → `commit` (earliest event after the navigation actually
  commits to a new document)

tab_id.description: Target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's currently active tab.

timeout_ms.description: Hard upper bound on the wait. Defaults to 30s.

wait_until.description: Lifecycle phase to wait on. Defaults to [`WaitUntil::Load`].
